title: Post-meeting RI governance and intro orchestration defect
category: Transcript ingestion / RI mutation / loop lifecycle / intro governance
summary: RB produced smart meeting and transcript analysis, but failed canonical relationship-OS behavior: source-backed RI, proposed mutations, loop lifecycle, trust/reciprocity governance, intro candidate scoring, and persistence status.

defects.title: Transcript analysis did not mutate relationship state
defects.recommendation: Transcript ingestion must propose RI events, contact updates, relationship-stage changes, topic tags, trust/reciprocity scoring, and interaction briefs.

defects.title: Meeting completion did not close or create loops
defects.recommendation: Post-meeting ingestion must close meeting loops and propose follow-up, research, nurture, waiting-on, and cadence loops.

defects.title: Intro recommendation lacked governed candidate scoring
defects.recommendation: Score intro candidates for fit, trust maturity, reciprocity, operational readiness, and network-equity risk before recommending any intro.

defects.title: Reciprocity and trust were analyzed but not operationalized
defects.recommendation: Persist reciprocity/trust signals and make them visible in proposed mutation bundles.

defects.title: Multi-calendar ambiguity overtrusted
defects.recommendation: Run source readiness before interpreting empty calendar results.

regression_anchors: Hassan should not trigger high-network-equity intros yet; posture is low-frequency nurture.
Ashwin should trigger strategic-peer and Dog Haus POS opportunity tracking.
Ish Singh should be scored as promising but conditional with operational maturity and international-readiness risks unresolved.
Good advice with no mutation proposal is a failing response for transcript-bearing RI.
